fair_value_reason: Round-4 blends are $6.51 / $3.50 / $4.70 / $4.58 / $7.51 (mean $5.36). Corrections: agent 1 to ~$6.48 (A201 133 racks); agent 2 to ~$3.41 (A202 fee at ~10% not WACC, 133 racks); agent 3 to ~$4.57 (Tydal LC rate 8.0% -> ~9% after re-basing to today's Treasuries, 133 racks); agent 4 to ~$4.54 (133 racks); agent 5 to ~$5.55 (DCF $5.19 -> $3.39: LC/Volta rates 7.0/9.5% -> 9/11%, NPV-zero refresh, A202 fee at ~10%, mining terminal -3% for the 2032 halving, R&D held ~$90M, partly offset by removing CoinShares' allocated interest, BTC paths weighted 50/50; SOTP $8.18 -> ~$4.9 on the same fixes; EV/sales $11.54 kept). Corrected mean ~$4.9, ~54% below the $10.64 spot. The gap is option value on BTC, a second lease and market multiples on powered MW.
supervisor_summary: In round 4 all five forecasters valued every inventory site once and split discount rates. After my fixes the split-rate DCFs run -$2.34 to $3.39 (mean ~-$0.05) and single-rate -$2.84 to $2.99 (mean ~-$0.50). Agent 5's $5.19 was the outlier: a 7% Tydal rate below the TeraWulf evidence, positive-NPV GPU refresh, an A202 fee at WACC, a mining perpetuity that ignores the 2032 halving and an unsupported R&D cut, partly offset by a real interest double count in the CoinShares cost it uses. Corrected fair value is ~$4.9 against a $10.64 spot. I shade the ladder ~3% lower (P(>=spot) 0.36) with medium confidence; thesis break is $5.0. The stock is a leveraged option on BTC and a second lease, with no checked edge over SPY.
key_drivers: BTC/hashprice into the April-2028 halving: mining is still ~65-70% of 2027 revenue. Agent 5's corrected DCF is $5.77 on a rising-BTC path and $1.01 flat, and agent 4's hashprice +/-20% gives +$1.76/-$6.31
On cash flows alone EV ~= net debt. Corrected split-rate DCFs run -$2.34 to $3.39 (mean ~-$0.05) and single-rate -$2.84 to $2.99 (mean ~-$0.50), so splitting the discount rate adds only ~$0.45/sh

Tydal: $233M yr-1 rent from ~2027-04-01. ~$1.3B LCs still 'anticipated'. Worth ~$0.9-1.0B net of capex at a ~9% LC-backed / ~11% Volta-only rate; TeraWulf's backstopped 7.75% notes, re-based to a 5.29% 10Y, anchor ~9%, not 7%

Malaysia GPU cloud: A102 >$800M signed; A201 >70% 'commitments' (>$1.7B / 5 yrs), 133 GB300 racks procured; A202 65.1 MW with no offtake and a 10-yr fee Bitdeer pays. Whether refresh cycles earn above their cost of capital moves agents 1 and 5 by ~$1.5-1.7/sh, more than GPU life does

Corporate cost and the mining cost base: $112M/yr of R&D plus ~$105M of G&A (H1-26 FS). CoinShares' cash cost already holds allocated G&A and ~$9.75k/BTC of interest, so agents using it must neither add G&A nor deduct interest twice
